description: This file declares the ICapture interface for the WPEFramework project, including its nested IStore interface, which manages image buffer storage and conversion methods. It provides functions to obtain the capture interface's name, perform screen capture, and retrieve an instance of the interface.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen images, providing functions to access capture features and instantiate the interface.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture::IStore
classes.description: A helper interface for storing or converting image buffers, supporting a specific pixel format.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the ICapture interface.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs a screen capture and stores the image data using the provided IStore instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the ICapture interface.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
